publisher: Mississippi Secretary of State, Business Services & Regulation

access.automation: The public reporting page supports filtering and Excel export up to 300,000 results; a full export requires contacting Business Services, and no API or unattended recurring route is published.
access.fees: The public report is described as free; fees and terms for a full export are not published on the reviewed page.

fields: Published columns include business name/ID, other names, profile and domicile type, status, three NAICS codes, address, city, state, county, postal code, and formation date.
active_status_semantics: The database includes current registered businesses and a status field, but status is registry standing, not evidence of present operation; the value dictionary is not published on the landing page.
statewide_completeness: The page says all current registered businesses in Mississippi, which excludes unregistered activity and does not establish historical or dissolved-entity completeness.
address_and_zip: Address line, city, state, county, and postal code are explicit columns, but the address role and organization control are not defined.
redistribution: Free query/export availability does not establish indefinite retention, geocoding, transformation, derived publication, or redistribution rights.
temporal_refresh: The report identifies current registrations but publishes no snapshot timestamp, refresh cadence, delta/deletion/replay contract, manifest, or checksum.

citations.supports: scope, columns, Excel limit, and full-export contact requirement
Business Services authority and registry responsibilities

next_action: Obtain written full-export terms, a header-only sample, status/address dictionaries, refresh controls, supported automation, and redistribution rights if authorized later. Do not export, contact, sign up, scrape, download, or execute production from this assessment.
